content: Jesus Jerusalenma yaicushcamanda
Jerusalen llactama riushcai Olivos urcuibi tiyauc Betfagé Betania llactagunai caillayasha Jesus ishcai (2) japishcagunata cachara chasna nisha,

Canguna ñaupacpi auc ichilla llactama ringuichi. Chi llactai yaicusha shuc malta burro huatashca shayauta tupanguichimi. Paihua huashaibi pihuas chara mana tiyariushca achun. Chita pascasha apamunguichi.
Maican runas cangunata imangahuata chasna ranguichi nisha tapunaupiga rimanguichi, ñucanchi amumi munan, mana unayachishachu cutichingami.
Paiguna risha burro ñambibi shuc pungu mayanbi huatashcata tupasha pascanaura.
Pascaupi chibi tiyauc runaguna tapunaura, Imangahuata chi burrota pascaunguichi.
Chi japishcaguna Jesus nishcashinata cuintacpi apailla ninaura.
Chasna rasha Jesuspagma chi malta burrota apanaura. Paigunaga llachapagunata burro huashaibi mandasha Jesusta tiyachinaura.
Maican runaguna paita mandac amutashina rasha pai purina ñambibi llachapagunata mandanaura, shuccunaga ruya pangayuc pallcagunata chagragunai pitisha ñambibi shitanaura.
Ñáaupapunda riucunahuas, huasha puriucunahuas Jesusta catisha riusha caparinaura casna nisha,

content.text: Dios cachashca shamuc ashami balichishca achun.
Ñáucanchi huañuc apayayagunata mandac rey amu David mandashcashina pactamushcami canga mandangamiraungui.
Jahuapachai auc Dios alabashca achun nisha caparinaura.

content: Jesus Jerusalenma pactasha Diosta alabana huasima rira. Tucuita ricushcahuasha ña chishiyaupi pai japishca runagunandi Betania nishca llactama rira.
Jesus mana aparic ruyata chaquichishcamanda
Cayandi Betaniamanda llucshisha Jerusalenma riushcai paita raicachira.

Carumanda shuc pangayuc higo nishca ruyata ricusha chima rira muyuyucchari an nisha. Chara mana muyu aparina uras agllaita pangamuilla tiyaushcata ricusha caillayara ricungahua randi pangagunallata tupara.
Chasna acpi Jesus chi ruyata nira, Mana ima uraspas cuti aparicchu tucungui runa micungahua. Chi japishcagunaga pai rimashcata uyanaura.
Diospa huasi pungüi randichiucunata Jesus callpachira

Jerusalenma pactasha Jesus Diosta alabana huasima rira. Chibi randichiucunata randiucunatas chimanda callpachingahua callarira. Chasnallata pai urmachira cullquita cambiachina mesagunatas, randichina palomagunata churashca taulagunatas.
Tucui randichiucunatas jarcara Diosta alabana huasi partima yaicungahua nicpi.
Chasna rashcahuasha paigunata rimara, Manachu quillcashca tiyan, Ñáuca huasiga tucui runa muntun shamusha Dioshuan cuintana huasi nishca manga. Randi canguna shuhuana huasita rashcanguichi.

Jesus rimashcata uyasha israel pagrigunahua amuguna, Moises mandashcagunata yachaucunandi tapunacunaura, Imasna rashata paita huanchishunchi nisha mascaunaura. Randi tucui runaguna pai yachachishcata cushihuan uyaunaupi paita manzhanaura.
Ñáa tutayaupi Jesus pai japishcagunandi llactamanda llucshisha rira.
Jesus mana aparic ruyata chaquichishcamanda
Cayandi tutamanda ñambita riusha chi higo ruyata chaquirishcata ricunaura.
Pedro chita ricusha nira, Ricui señor, can piñasha rimashca ruya chaquirishcami nira.
Chasna nicpi Jesus rimara, Yaya Diostaga quirichi.
Maican runahuas cai urcuta, can tiyaushcamanda anchurisha lamarma urmagri nisha rimacpi ringami. Chi runa paihua shungu ucuibi chasna tucuchun nisha quiricpi pai quirishcacuinta tucungami.
Sirtupacha cangunata nini, Canguna imatahuas Yaya Diosta shunguhuan tapucpi ña japishcanimi nisha quirishaga cuitucunguichimi.
Canguna Yaya Diosta tapushcai shuc runa canda piñashcata yuyarisha, ñaupallata paita perdunasha cungaringui camba Yaya Dios canda perdunasha cungarichun.
Randi canguna shucta mana perdunasha cungaricpi canguna jahuapachaibi auc Yaya canguna juchagunatahuas mana perdunasha cungaringachu nira.
Pitan Jesusta mandac
Jerusalenbi ña pactanaura. Jesus Diosta alabana huasi partibi puriupi pagri amugunas, Moises mandashcagunata yachaccunahuas, israelgunata mandac rucugunahuas paihuagma shamusha tapunaura,
Ima ushaihuanda chigunata rangui. Pita canda chita rachun nishaga mandara.
Jesus casna nira, Ñáucahuas cangunata shuc tapunata tapungarauni cutipahuaichi. Canguna cutipacpi ñucahuas pi ushaihuan caigunata ñuca raushcata cangunata rimashcanguichi.
Rimahuaichi, pita Juandaga cachara bautisachun nisha. Dioschu paita cachara, runagunachu paita cachara. Chita rimahuaichi nira.
Chasna tapucpi paigunapura rimanacunaura, Diosmi paita cachara nisha rimacpiga pai ñucanchita rimanma imangahuata Juanda mana quiriranguichi nisha.

Randi runaguna paita cachanaura nisha rimacpiga imasata ninga, nisha cuintanacunaura. Ñáa tucui runaguna Juanga Dios rimashcata pasachic runa mara nisha yuyarishcaunami. Runaguna chasna yuyaricpi chi amuguna manzhasha cutipanata mana munanaurachu, runaguna ñucanchita piñanaunga nisha manzhashcamanda.
Chasna acpi Jesusta rimanaura, Mana yachanchichu. Chasna rimanaupi Jesus randi paigunata nira, Canguna mana rimacpiga ñucahuas mana rimashcanguichichu ñuca pi mandashcahuan caita rauni nira.
